name: AI Automation
text: Autonomous AI agents for lead management and coordination, LLM document and data-entry automation, voice agents, chatbots, and AI embedded into a client's existing SaaS stack. Built with Python, FastAPI, OpenAI, LangChain, PyTorch and Pinecone.

name: Software Development
text: Full-stack web and mobile development, backend APIs, dashboards, custom business platforms, MVP builds and legacy system migration. Stack includes Python, FastAPI, Postgres and Supabase.

name: Cloud Systems
text: Cloud infrastructure and deployment on AWS and Azure, cloud migration, scalable and secure architecture, uptime and zero-trust deployment.

name: Technical SEO and Digital Marketing
text: Technical SEO, performance ads, CRM automation, funnel optimisation, organic lead growth and search ranking improvements.

name: Cynbit Studio
text: Career intelligence and edtech SaaS: adaptive placement tests, AI code evaluation, AI mentor, mock interviews, resume engine and job matching. Suited to colleges, training institutes and placement cells.

name: Revio
text: AI review management assistant: cross-platform review sync, AI-drafted replies, sentiment analysis and crisis detection. Suited to restaurants, hotels, clinics, local businesses and retail brands with online reviews.

name: TenantEase
text: Property and tenant management SaaS: rent tracking, automatic reminders, tenant records and a landlord dashboard. Suited to landlords, property managers and housing companies.

name: BitElevate
text: Training and internship program for students and early-career engineers with tracks such as AI, ML, NLP, data science and full-stack development, mentorship and industry projects. Not a client service; route student or internship inquiries here.

name: Engagement process
text: Six steps: discovery and audit, strategy and blueprinting, high-fidelity design, technical implementation, quality and integrity check, deployment and evolution. Discovery is the entry point via the contact page.
